extracted.name: Vegan bread sauce
extracted.description: Make a vegan version of bread sauce, made with soya milk and vegan butter. Serve as a side at Sunday lunch, or at Christmas time with all the trimmings
instruction_lines: Simmer the milk, butter, onion, cloves, peppercorns, garlic and herbs in a pan over a low heat for 20 mins. Strain and return the liquid to the pan.

Add the breadcrumbs and simmer for another 3-4 mins. Add the nutmeg, then season and serve. Can be made up to three days in advance, cooled completely and reheated on the hob until piping hot, or in the microwave on medium for 3 mins.
